blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–The Philippines women’s soft tennis fell to heavy favorite Japan, 2-0, in the semifinals on Sunday to finish with a bronze medal in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. Bien Zoleta and Princess Catindig lost, 4-0, 4-1, 4-2, 4-0, 4-1, to Rena Temma and Kiyo Miyamae before Christy Sanosa was beaten by Ayaka Iwakura, 4-0, 4-0, 4-1, 4-2, 4-2. Shyryn Salazar and Hillary Paas’ match against Rio Maeda and Sakura Nakatani was not played after Japan completed the sweep. Soft tennis earned the distinction as the country’s first medal […]...
